name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
desc: The square that becomes a nightly circus — drummers, storytellers, orange juice for pennies. Broke-friendly since forever.

name: Jardin Majorelle
desc: That electric-blue garden all over your feed. Cacti, YSL lore, and shade genuinely worth saving for.

name: Bahia Palace
desc: Room after room of carved cedar and zellige built purely to drop jaws. Yours included.

name: Koutoubia Mosque
desc: The 12th-century minaret the whole city navigates by. Sunset from the rose gardens costs exactly nothing.

name: Ben Youssef Madrasa
desc: A 16th-century student dorm that out-decorates every palace hotel. The courtyard is a someday-list classic.

name: Saadian Tombs
desc: Royal tombs hidden behind a wall for centuries, dripping in marble and gold leaf. Secrets keep well here.

name: Le Jardin Secret
desc: An Islamic garden tucked mid-souk — trickling water channels, real silence, and a tower over the rooftops.

name: Menara Gardens
desc: Olive groves, a pavilion, a still pool, and the Atlas floating behind it all. A free postcard you can walk into.

name: The Medina Souks
desc: Miles of lamps, leather, and rugs you'll haggle for someday. Getting gloriously lost is the actual attraction.
